table inet firewalld {
	ct helper helper-tftp-udp {
		type "tftp" protocol udp
		l3proto inet
	}

	set icmp-noise {
		type icmp_type
		elements = { echo-request, timestamp-request,
			     redirect, source-quench }
	}

	chain mangle_PREROUTING {
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle + 10; policy accept;
		jump mangle_PREROUTING_ZONES
	}

	chain mangle_PREROUTING_ZONES {
		iifname "lo" accept
		goto mangle_PRE_public
	}

	chain nat_PREROUTING {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat + 10; policy accept;
		jump nat_PREROUTING_POLICIES_pre
		jump nat_PREROUTING_ZONES
	}

	chain nat_PREROUTING_ZONES {
		goto nat_PRE_public
	}

	chain nat_PRE_public {
		jump nat_PRE_public_pre
		jump nat_PRE_public_allow
	}

	chain filter_INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter + 10; policy accept;
		ct state { established, related } accept
		ct status dnat accept
		iifname "lo" accept
		ct state invalid drop
		jump filter_INPUT_ZONES
		reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
	}

	chain filter_FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority filter + 10; policy accept;
		ct state { established, related } accept
		ct status dnat accept
		iifname "lo" accept
		ct state invalid drop
		reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
	}

	chain filter_IN_public_allow {
		tcp dport 22 accept
		ip6 daddr fe80::/64 udp dport 546 accept
		icmp type { redirect, source-quench } drop
		icmp type redirect drop
		ct status { dnat, snat } accept
	}
}
